items.title: Cracker Barrel CEO steps down a year after logo debacle
items.summary: Cracker Barrel's CEO is stepping down nearly a year after an attempted rebrand of the chain led to a fierce customer backlash.  Cracker Barrel said Monday that CEO Julie Masino will step down next month but remain with the company until Oct. 9 in an advisory capacity.  David Deno will succeed Masino on Aug. 10 as CEO.
